audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart carried a blanket Skill on rows 0-3 while content and packet say Xerath.
audit.why: Levels 1-5 Xerath's 750 Q outranges Brand's setup (W 900 with a windup, E only 625) and Brand's stun needs Blaze already applied; from 6 on both ult and it is a skillshot duel — Skill.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-3 side moved to Xerath with grounded whys; win[] already agreed so no content edits needed.

audit.why: Spikes present and accurate: 3-5 kill window, 6 duel, 1st item even, late skill. Lost Chapter/Luden's timings kept.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeBad/dontsFull[2].d referenced 'the dash' — Brand has no dash; cooldowns field had no number; missing interaction: Brand's Sear cancels Xerath's R channel.
audit.why: Brand Q 8s rank 1 stuns only ablaze targets; R Pyroclasm 100s; E only 625 range. Xerath R is an interruptible channel so any landed Sear (while ablaze) ends the barrage.
audit.corrected: Trade lines rewritten around the Blaze-stun combo, cooldowns given real numbers, channel-cancel folded into breakdown.mid.

audit.why: Pyroclasm 100s is the punishable window; Sear 8s rank 1.

edits.before: Q from fog-of-war range on his every last-hit — level 1 Xerath is the longest gun in the lane. Mana is the only governor.
edits.after: Your 750 Q pokes him for free while his stun needs Blaze stacks he cannot apply at level 1. Tax every last-hit; watch mana.

edits.before: W joins the pattern: Q-W on the slowed target is the chip combo that defines the next twenty minutes.
edits.after: W joins in: Q into the 1000-range W chips him before his two-part stun setup exists. He cannot answer.

edits.before: E completes the kill kit: the stun into full rotation is real damage even now. Hold it for HIS aggression, not yours.
edits.after: E completes the kit: his W has a visible windup — sidestep it and the ablaze stun never happens. Hold E for his commit.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — the artillery goes infinite. Poke the wave contact, the trade attempt, and the recall walk.
edits.after: Lost Chapter — your poke goes free while his combo still needs him 900 range deep. Chip the wave contact and recall walk.

edits.before: Spending E on chip and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive on schedule — the stun is your only 'no' and everyone knows it.
edits.after: Standing ablaze inside his 1050-range Sear line — once his passive is on you, his Q stuns and the full combo follows. Trade unstacked.

edits.before: Good trade: Q the last-hit from beyond his answer range, W the lateral dodge, and walk — a one-way trade he can only end by leaving the lane. Bad trade: Spending E on chip and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive on schedule — the stun is your only 'no' and everyone knows it.
edits.after: Good trade: Q the last-hit from beyond his answer range, W the lateral dodge, and walk — a one-way trade he can only end by leaving the lane. Bad trade: Standing ablaze inside his 1050-range Sear line — once his passive is on you, his Q stuns and the full combo follows. Trade unstacked.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Shocking Orb has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — 8s at rank 1, and it only stuns while you are ablaze; after eating his W or E, that stun line is the dodge that matters. - His R Pyroclasm is 100s — his kill threat vanishes when it is down. - Your 13s E answers his 625-range Conflagration step-up.

edits.before: Post-6 you shove-and-snipe: crash the wave, R the chipped, and rotate your barrage to every river contest — your poke decides objectives you never attend.
edits.after: Post-6 shove-and-snipe, but his Sear cancels your R channel — only ult from fog or once his Q is spent, and rotate barrages to every river contest.

edits.before: Q the last-hit from beyond his answer range, W the lateral dodge, and walk — a one-way trade he can only end by leaving the lane.
edits.after: Brand has no gap-closer, so E is not an escape here — it is the interrupt that stops his W-into-E stun setup. Save it for that.

edits.before: Spending E on chip and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive on schedule — the stun is your only 'no' and everyone knows it.
edits.after: His Sear reaches 1050 — nearly your Q range. Poke from max distance with your 1000-range W and never sit inside his stun-combo line.

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Brand wins by stacking Blaze with W or E, stunning you with Sear, and detonating the full passive-fed combo.

notes: Packet suspectName 'Land Pillar of Flame' in wants.foe[0] is a FALSE POSITIVE — Pillar of Flame is Brand's real W per the kit; no edit made. Full-layer rows 0-3 aligned to the content/packet chart (win[] already correct, so paired edits would be no-ops). tradeBad/dontsFull[2].d referenced a dash Brand does not have — template bleed from a dash enemy, rewritten. Channel-cancel (Sear interrupts Rite of the Arcane) folded into breakdown.mid. Rows 4-6 already agree as Skill on both layers — untouched.
